case: Case 1 - children under five -> vaccination candidate sites (health facilities + school candidates)
candidate_sites_note: Health facilities AND schools are CANDIDATE vaccination sites only. No site has been verified as an actual vaccination location. School ids are namespaced 'school_<osm_id>'; health facility ids are unchanged OSM ids. REAL capacities are missing for both classes (blank capacity column).
balanced_ot_note: Balanced optimal transport requires sum(x) == sum(y). Facility capacities are MISSING (OSM has no capacity data), so this dataset is NOT yet ready for real-world capacity-constrained optimization. Use synthetic capacities (labeled) for method development only.
capacity_status: missing - no verified capacity source integrated yet
road_distance_status: unavailable: local OSRM not reachable; the stale matrix (built for the previous 320-site dataset) was removed from data/processed/case1/. Restart OSRM (scripts/start_osrm.sh) and rerun scripts/run_pipeline.py --from-existing to rebuild it for the combined sites. Road distances are never substituted with straight-line values.
